overview_description.description: Fenix Games is a Web3 gaming publisher and blockchain gaming company focused on transforming the gaming industry through decentralized technologies, blockchain integration, and digital ownership. Founded by gaming and investment industry veterans, the company publishes, acquires, and invests in Web2, Web2.5, and Web3 games to build next-generation gaming ecosystems.
